async function ensureRow(m: PrismaModelLike, where: Record<string, unknown>, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  return (await m.findFirst({ where })) ?? (await m.create({ data }));
}
/** The row identified by the unique `key` with `pins` applied: updated in place when it exists, created otherwise. */
async function ensurePinned(m: PrismaModelLike, key: Record<string, unknown>, pins: Record<string, unknown>, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const existing = await m.findFirst({ where: key });
  if (existing === null) return m.create({ data });
  await m.updateMany({ where: key, data: pins });
  return (await m.findFirst({ where: key })) ?? existing;
}

function get(value: unknown, path: string[]): unknown {
  let cur: unknown = value;
  for (const seg of path) {

    cur = (cur as Record<string, unknown>)[seg];

  return cur;
}
function altered(v: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof v === "string") return `${v}_x`;
  if (typeof v === "number") return v + 1;
  if (typeof v === "bigint") return v + 1n;
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return !v;
  if (v instanceof Date) return new Date(v.getTime() + 86_400_000);
  return "altered";
}
function bump(v: unknown, delta: number): unknown {
  if (typeof v === "number") return v + delta;
  if (typeof v === "bigint") return v + BigInt(delta);
  if (v instanceof Date) return new Date(v.getTime() + delta * 86_400_000);
  if (typeof v === "string" && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(v))) return new Date(Date.parse(v) + delta * 86_400_000);
  throw new Error(`cannot offset ${String(v)} by ${delta}`);
}

}

}
function emittedCount(trace: TraceLike | null, event: string): number {
  const emit = trace?.phases.find((p) => p.phase === "emit");
  return (emit?.events ?? []).filter((e) => e.event === event).length;
}
